messages:
sara: :rotating_light: ValenHealth reports repeated websocket disconnects and 504s via their App Gateway. Spikes started ~08:05 UTC. Noticing lots of client retries and some 502/504 surfacing in our gateway logs. Paging on-call.
incident-bot: Incident created and page sent to @oncall-sre. Incident ID INC-178945. Severity: P1. Channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime. Triage checklist posted.
ben: I'm oncall — joining. Can someone paste a sample log line?
valen-sre: ValenHealth SRE here. From our side: clients see a 101 handshake, then after a few seconds the stream becomes stuck and clients backoff and retry. Our side shows repeated `RST_STREAM` and `stream timeout`.
irene: Noted. Customer impact: multiple production customers on ValenHealth app (billing notifications) affected. They're reporting delays and duplicated sends.
jon: Quick check — our routing for ValenHealth goes to a Dedicated VPC pool (valen-dedicated-1) + edge App Gateway proxy. Only that tenant's routes bound to the dedicated pool.
ben: logs from edge showing a ton of 504s to the dedicated pool: ```
[08:06:12 UTC] ingress-proxy valen-route: upstream request timed out after 30s -> 504
[08:06:13 UTC] connection reset by peer, stream_id=98765
[08:06:15 UTC] rate: retries=6 client_ip=10.2.3.4
```
sara: Looks like client retries + exchange timeouts causing cascading backpressure on the dedicated pool.
valen-sre: We also saw our app gw (third-party) spike retry attempts when we had transient packet loss. Their client retries are tight (0,200,400ms) without jitter. Lots of concurrent reconnects.
ben: Ok two-fold problem: 1) customer-side aggressive retries, 2) our dedicated pool not shedding load gracefully for streaming sessions leading to backend timeouts. Proposed live mitigations:
- apply per-tenant admission control on valen-route (limit concurrent streaming sessions)
- increase grpc/websocket idle timeout at edge to avoid premature 504s while we stabilize
- add jittered retry guidance to ValenHealth (customer-led)
- scale up valen-dedicated pool by +50% temporarily
jon: I'll push admission control and timeout changes now. Ben, want me to scale first or do rate-limit first?
ben: Rate-limit first to stop the retry storm, then scale.
ops-bot: Running: ```kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: valen-routing-tmp
data:
  envoy.filters.http.router: |
    route_config:
      virtual_hosts:
      - name: valen_vh
        routes:
        - match: { prefix: "/v1/valen/" }
          route:
            cluster: valen-dedicated-1
            retry_policy: { retry_on: "5xx,connect-failure", num_retries: 1 }
            timeout: 60s
            per_filter_config:
              envoy.filters.http.local_ratelimit:
                token_bucket: { max_tokens: 1000, tokens_per_fill: 100, fill_interval: "1s" }
EOF
```
ops-bot: Config applied to edge route valen-route, timeout bumped to 60s, retry num_retries=1, local rate limit enabled.
valen-sre: Thanks — we'll throttle client retries as well. Sending patch to our SDK to add jitter and exponential backoff.
irene: Customer comms: drafting message to ValenHealth PM with requested mitigation steps and ETA.
ben: Scaling dedicated pool now: ```
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy valen-dedicated-pool --replicas=6  # was 4
```
ben: Scaled. Watching metrics.
sara: Observability: @jon can you open a dashboard for per-route active streams and CPU/GPU queue length for valen-dedicated-1?
jon: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/d/valen/streams (shared). Active streams dropping from 12k -> 3k after rate-limit, CPU queue depth down ~70%.
valen-sre: We're seeing a dramatic reduction in reconnects. Client-side retry PR merged and rolling out now.
ben: Also disabled prefix caching for that route temporarily (caching was keeping long-lived KV entries causing memory pressure). Patch:
```bash
redwoodctl route update valen-route --disable-prefix-cache
```
incident-bot: Timeline note added: applied edge rate-limit, bumped timeout to 60s, scaled pool to 6, disabled prefix-cache, customer applying client retry fix.
sara: Any remaining 5xx/504 rates?
jon: 504s reduced to <0.2% of previous. Streaming disconnects trending to baseline.
valen-sre: Customer reports delivery delays cleared. No duplicates since we reduced retries.
irene: Sending update to ValenHealth: mitigation applied, recommend client retry jitter + 500ms base, monitor for 24h. Would you like us to run a controlled failover test to hosted fallback for future resilience?
valen-sre: Yes, please. We'll coordinate a maintenance window next Tue.
ben: Next steps (postmortem):
- root cause: interplay of client aggressive retries + per-tenant resource exhaustion in dedicated pool
- remediation: tighter per-tenant admission controls, default client retry guidance in our integration guide, add automated detection for tenant-level retry storms
- follow-ups: run chaos test with simulated retry storms against dedicated pools
sara: Great. Moving to resolved if metrics remain stable for next hour. Marking INC-178945 as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-178945 status changed to MITIGATED by sara at 08:52 UTC. Postmortem assigned to ben, jon. 72h doc due.
ben: I'll take the postmortem. Adding notes to ops runbook about increasing edge timeout when client SDKs shown to be aggressive.
valen-sre: Thanks everyone for the quick assist. We'll follow up after our internal changes.
sara: Closing thread in 1h if stable. Thanks team. :pray:
